title: PhaseClosure
description: Machine-recorded closure of a phase or round (D-110, governance-roadmap item 4). Replaces the hand-narrated portion of closing D-entries: gate posture, batch list, validation criteria, and the no-deletion flag become data; derived properties (consecutive-streak counters, scope trends) are computed from the ledger by `devai govern phase ledger`, never stored as prose. The closing D-entry shrinks to a human judgment plus a pointer to this record. Written by `devai govern phase close` to record/proofs/compliance/closures/PC-NNNN.json (tracked, append-only by convention: a recorded closure is never edited; corrections append a new record with `supersedes`).

id.description: Sequential closure id. Assigned by `devai govern phase close` as max(existing) + 1.

round_id.description: Human identifier of the closed unit, e.g. 'phase-39', 'round-14', 'drift-remediation'.

title.description: One-line headline of what the phase/round shipped.

declaring_decision.description: The D-entry that declared the phase/round.

closing_decision.description: The D-entry that records the closing judgment.

commit.description: Commit SHA the batch landed as. Optional for batches folded into the closing commit.

gates.description: Gate-sweep results at close, keyed by gate name (e.g. lint, typecheck, unit, integration, contract, docs-links, docs-governance, spec-validate-all).

source_repo_deleted.description: Whether the phase/round deleted an absorbed source repo. The consecutive no-deletion streak is computed from this field by `devai govern phase ledger` — never hand-narrated.

supersedes.description: Set when this record corrects an earlier closure; the earlier record's bytes stay untouched.

merged_as.description: The integration-branch commit the closed round actually shipped as (merge commit or branch tip on main). Historical records remain schema-valid without this field, but every new successor record emitted by `devai govern phase close` requires it.

release_disposition.description: Whether the round's package changes have a release path: 'published' (release cut), 'changeset-pending' (changeset recorded, publish pending), 'none-preratification' (package-visible changes intentionally withheld until ratification), 'none-needed' (no package-visible changes), or 'missing' (package changes shipped with no changeset — a recorded defect, never a silent one). Historical records remain schema-valid without this field, but every new successor record emitted by `devai govern phase close` requires it.

evidence.description: Machine-evidence epoch bound by this closure. The terminal hash commits to the complete line-hash chain.

batches.headline: Constitution 0.2.0 -> 0.3.0 (Articles 1, 23, 27); BUILD-PLAN history frozen to archive; README/CLAUDE refresh; docs_drift schema enum; D-108
